verdict.rationale: Docs claim the platform can 'synthesize conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers' and produce cited, auditable reports tracing findings back to source passages, which implies some handling of disagreement between sources. However, there is no concrete description of a UI or output format that explicitly surfaces agreement/disagreement across sources (e.g., a side-by-side or consensus/dissent view) — it's only mentioned in passing marketing language. Missing for 10: a documented feature or example output showing explicit surfacing of conflicting source viewpoints, independent/hands-on corroboration of this behavior.
